attributes.action: To teach any child who turns up to school ready to learn
attributes.additional_details: Schools refusing to teach children that turn up on time to school ready to learn only to be refused entry and sent home due to what they are wearing if it doesn't meet that particular schools rules is an issue Attendance is an issue in the UK  I believe that if a child attends school on time and is ready to learn something they should be taught by teacher's that are paid to do that job Being refused entry to school in above 30° heat if they're not wearing full school uniform is not right
attributes.background: If a child turns up to school on time ready to learn then they shouldn't be refused entry excluded suspended or sent home due to what they are wearing. Attendance is an issue within schools lately. The weather is also an issue. Being refused entry to learn for not wearing ties, blazers etc

rejection.details: Rule enforcement is a matter for schools, nor for the Government or Parliament.
